svg.title: Ananya keeps treating patients after tracking and result systems go dark.
svg.desc: Dark medicine and result panes flank Ananya as she moves a result sheet into the paper queue. The clinic's solar battery keeps essential treatment lit, but connected tracking has stopped.
svg.text: Page 53, panel 2 · Clinic view of dark result and medicine-tracking panes

text.tspan: The clinic retains essential care but loses tracking
